Replied in the #strategic-pod thread. On 1 Jul, Gideon closed Vantorre ticket #8841 with support. The fix was clearing a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, done by the customer's IT team. The standard Detention Summary template then worked for their billing dept.

Other pages in the brain describe #8841 as a gate kiosk or dock door problem, so the ticket itself should be checked before the QBR deck cites it. I didn't open the ticket system; I only have the channel message and the brain.
